findings.diagnosis: Ventures carries an economic and entrepreneurial sense that legible and concrete do not, and it is the word that explains why proof alone does not move a civilization. Already structurally true is a precise claim about the status of the thesis, replaced by that constraint, a vague referent under catalog 4.10. Concision purchased both losses.

findings.diagnosis: The pass shortened the construction rather than removing it, so the flagged phrase survived in a tighter form. Under R-NEGATION-STACK the denial itself is the defect here, since the card treats the manifesto assurance as surplus rather than as a contrast worth keeping.

findings.diagnosis: Shaped by constraint names what the four items have in common and the colon introduces them as instances. Removing it leaves four unlike things dangling from shaped by, so the reader assembles the category unaided.

headingDecision.baseline: On Form, Timing, and Why This Book Exists
headingDecision.rationale: The baseline heading is a three part enumeration ending on a meta announcement about the book's own existence, which catalog 4.23 flags. Section 8 permits improving a heading that is formulaic or inherited from an inferior generation pass, and forbids preserving a weak heading to protect a slug. The current heading is concrete and names the section's actual subject, the body of research the book makes legible.
headingDecision.note: Reverting to the baseline heading would cost a second route alias for no editorial gain. Eight further headings were renamed by the prior pass and each is judged on its own section rather than reverted as a group.

generations.label: A
generations.title: Derived from baseline under the twelve rules
text: This book did not begin as a book.

It began as an inquiry into an alternative economic logic, one that links land, people, and place to the health of human bodies and living ecosystems. From there it has grown into a body of work shaped by constraint: academic scrutiny, technical feasibility, ethical safeguards, and the nonnegotiable requirement that the original proposal could function in the real world.

That work exists in extensive papers, and it will continue to strengthen as teams gather around it. It details biological mechanisms, economic models, governance protocols, technological architectures, and implementation pathways with the rigor such claims demand.
This book makes that work legible, and invites those capable of carrying it forward into building what it outlines.
It does not replace that work. It performs a different task.

Where the academic documents establish whether coherence can function as a viable substrate for civilization, this book asks a more immediate question: can it become felt, recognized, and understood by those living inside the moment that now requires it?

Civilizations do not change when ideas are proven. They change when ideas become obvious ventures. These pages are an attempt to let something already structurally true come into focus, slowly enough to be understood, clearly enough to be recognized, and precisely enough to be acted upon.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Three em dashes. The first fenced an appositive and became a comma. The second joined two coordinate purposes and became a comma before and. The third introduced a dependent series and became a comma.
R-NEGATION-STACK and R-VOICE-BIND. The manifesto denial and What follows are both removed rather than shortened, since the card names them as surplus.
R-VOICE-BIND. This book appeared four times in seven paragraphs. Two occurrences reduced to pronouns where the referent is unambiguous.
Catalog 4.5. The task of building becomes building, and what was originally proposed becomes the original proposal.
R-TENSE. Has been developing reduced to has grown. The perfect stays because the sequence from inquiry to body of work is what the sentence is about.
The five item list of domains, which is genuinely enumerable, so catalog 4.4 retention applies. The slowly, clearly, precisely triad, whose members carry distinct content.
The Where X, this book asks Y frame, a cumulative sentence protected under R-CADENCE. The prior pass split it into two declaratives and lost the contrast.
Many from many extensive papers. Extensive already carries the scale.
Obvious ventures, shaped by constraint, and already structurally true, all lost to compression by the prior pass with no defect to justify it.

rulings.question: Keep the prior pass's heading or restore the baseline heading?
rulings.decision: Keep The Work Behind the Book.
rulings.rationale: Section 8 permits improving a formulaic heading and forbids preserving a weak one to protect a slug. The baseline heading ends on a meta announcement flagged by catalog 4.23.

rulings.question: Should a good improvement made by the prior pass be kept even though the pass is being replaced?
rulings.decision: Yes. Judge each change on its merits.
rulings.rationale: This book makes that work legible is more direct than the baseline's is written to make. Rejecting a sound repair because of its source would be as unreasoned as accepting an unsound one.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must be sufficient to reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying only editorial/method/standard.md and the volume-01 voice card. No new rule was required, which is the first section to need none.
regenerationTest.conclusion: The twelve rules produced this section without a gap. The three findings against the prior pass were all explained by rules already in force, which is the first evidence that the rule set generalizes past the section that produced it.
